issues.detail: Hebrew 'בְּלִיל חָמִיץ' means 'salted/fermented fodder' (a mixture of grain and herbs), not 'lúa mì' (wheat). The Vietnamese adds 'lúa mì' which is not in the Hebrew.
Hebrew 'בָּרַחַת' means 'with a shovel' (winnowing fork), not 'cối xay' (millstone). The Vietnamese mistranslates the instrument.
Hebrew 'בַּמִּזְרֶה' means 'with a winnowing fork', not 'cái rổ' (basket). The Vietnamese mistranslates the instrument.
